_comment: BLOCKING RULE. Before shipping any @ericriesactual TikTok: grep its video id here AND confirm Eric is on camera. Caption content is not a reliable signal. Eric has removed AI-generated TikTok entries from the site three times (2026-05-28, 2026-06-01, 2026-06-06). If you cannot confirm on-camera, SKIP.
_rules: Podcast-cutout pattern ('X and I discuss ... on the Y Podcast') is animated by default — skip unless on-camera is confirmed.
Photo slideshows (isSlideshow true, videoMeta.duration 0) are never eligible: Eric is not on camera, and /embed/v2/ cannot render photo mode so the facade renders black.
This list only grows. Add ids as they are identified; never remove one.
